annotations.text:
The demo opens here. Switch the verdict with the buttons top-right — BLOCKED / PASS / INCONCLUSIVE — to show all three gate outcomes without touching a pipeline. Click any finding to expand it.

Real data: the five blocking findings are what the planted installer actually produces.

The fleet view. Every number here is from a real scan — including the 203 MB NVIDIA installer, which unpacks three levels deep (NSIS → 7z → asar) to 120 files.

Click a row to select it; the filters and nav are live.

The AI setup wizard. Step through it with Continue — the interesting screen is step 3, which shows the exact payload that would leave the network for each redaction level.

That is the question a security team actually asks, so it is the centre of the flow rather than a checkbox.
